title: ID0415792-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / R6 170002064] HMI screen is broken
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
HMI screen is broken
Root cause:
Solution: HMI Screen replaced

additional_info.subject: HMI screen is broken- 1700002064
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
I visited this charging station after the customer told us that the HMI screen was without a display, meaning it was black and unresponsive.
After checking on the site, it appears that the screen is faulty and black with no display.
As is known in the new version update, as soon as a person connects the cable to the vehicle, the sensor indicator lights are supposed to turn on so that the user should not have any interaction with the HMI screen.
There are no indicator lights on the screen, both on the RFID and on the credit card reader even when the vehicle is connected.
Replaced with a DP cable and that didn't help either, in addition to the HMI controller there should be a green light that should indicate whether it is working or not, there was nothing..
After all these tests, the HMI screen was replaced with a new GEN 2 screen. After the replacement, everything worked again.
I am attaching a video of the tests I did and a photo before the replacement.
During the day, a warranty claims and Field Service Report will be sent to the current ticket.
Br,
Orel.
